book.name: Luka
book.title: Orooka o lebo ka Luka wele

content: O kabare ka Ashili ondo o gongo tesa geza a moole o Roma
Malo oka Yeso ka beke epaname a pate aromo ya konaza, aka ere naka ale apeng a Kaparnahum.
A nyimi apengme, ondoogong ona tesa geza a moole a Roma
waye ka ondo a nyimi azara wai oka waya kono na waya gbwǝ, ondo tesa geza a moole ome yeme ozara me ba bote.
A ondoogong ana o tesa geza omea wa tukǝ o kona oroka ba zaa Yeso, na wa tong anateandasau maYahuda
, kane bose kai adorana aka de kaka boze ozara wai tana wa gbwi ne.
Ko dukǝ one ba Yeso, nane bose kai ba cak, ane bekaana, “Oromo ona wa gwara o kankama wai.
Wa yeme aromo aro, kanza a wa sowa ro o dandaro gwarzanang maYahuda.”
Na Yeso ale kaa ne. Nangka ne amara ka akwilǝ me, na ondo tesa geza a moole me tong ajaa wai ba Yeso kane bekaa kai na, “Ateokora, tano gare okpwe ne, anta bare o deya akwilǝ ang ne.
Epa eka e ote na ma tonga ba bo naname, mi anta bare ang deya bo ne, ba sokoo beka ngmǝ, ozara ong yo woma.
Mi ang ya taara te ondo, kanza ka ana o tesa geza a moole cak ba taara tong, ma bekaa ondo one na wa ale, a wa ale, ma beka ondo na deya a wa de, ma beka ozara na wa ye epana, a wa ye.”
Nangka Yeso ka kone nyimi, na oroka me taru kai a lenyong, naka wangarno ba ana o tare kai, naka bekaa ne na, “Anta ma cǝ ondo a nyimi Isrela kawa kabare ka Ashili ka lenyong leyende na oromo na ne.”
Na aromo amea atong ne kuri ba akwilǝ me, ane mana ozara me a wa woma.
Yeso ka ara kena ka o agbwǝri ondayekamea ka gbwi
Malo nyimi na Yeso ale apeng amea beya ai na Nayin, ana o tare o kai ka aromo a cak ne ale ka kai.
Nangka ne amara ka buudu lyǝ apengme, nane laka aromo a surǝ ka ekeze ondasau omea a ngmeng wai a yende ba iini wai, ondaleme ondayeme wa rabo ko gbwǝ. A aromo a cak apengme a neye ka wai.
Nangka Ateokora ka laka ondayeme, na egonegone moke kai, naka beka ondayeme na, “Tana o ruuzi ne.”
Na Yeso ale naka moke ogǝkǝ o keze me, na ana o anza ekeze me itǝ tiiyi. A Yeso beke keze me na, “Ondasau, ma beka bo na era.”
Na ondooka wa gbwi wa ere a cikǝ, a wa bore o beya ngmǝ, na Yeso nya iini me wai.
Na boome be moke aromo me ba pate, aa ne saba Ashili. Ane bena, “Ondo o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili o gong wa ere a nyimi aro. Ashili a deya a boza aromo ai.”
Na oroka epa eka Yeso ka eza, wa ale ba kuruwǝ a nyimi Yahudiya ka makeke maame maya ma'amo ka maamane.
Yeso ka Yohana ondo batisma
Ana o tare o Yohana ondo batisma nane bele wai epa eka ne kona. Na ka rare anda leere ba nyimi one,
Na ka tong ne ba ra Ateokora kane pirkǝ na, “Boa Ondooka Ashili a zake ondooka waya deya na, te eke lenyong ba ondo kawa tata dimǝi?”
Nangka ne de ara Yeso, nane bekaana, “Yohana ondo batisma wa tonga ro ka te pirkau na, ‘Boa Ondooka Ashili a zake ondooka waya deya na, te eke lenyong ba ondo kawa tata dimǝi?’ ”
A were name, Yeso ka womza ana makono, ka na o bere o buru, a ka nya o gonta aza andaaka neta gonta ne.

Na Yeso kabare naka bekaa ne na, “kurǝ na ka e bekaa Yohana epa eka e kona, ka epa eka e laka. A pari a yizi rǝ, a gǝdǝ ya teweno, agangca ne cǝ lewoma, a pari teto te rara na neya konaza, andaaka ne gbwǝ ne era, kanza a beya oroka o lebo ara ana o dera.
Ondo kona o leba oromo oka wa ote lenyong le wai a mi.”
Malo kurǝ atoma Yohana, na Yeso bore o beya ngmǝ ka leguki le aromo aza Yohana, naka bekaana, “E ale o wake a laka eya? E ale ba laka ma wake ma ehywo mame obere ya pǝbǝ me na?
Nyimia wa taza ne, e ale a laka e ya? E ale a laka ondooka wa amba magogoro ma rere na? Ana o ambaza magogoro me mate, o cikǝ o lebo neya akwilǝ ogomoa.
Na eya e ale a laka me? Otoma Ashili na? Nyimia waa za, eyang bele o ying, wa kala otoma Ashili.
Yohana waya oromo ome angmǝ Ashili a bekaana,

content.text: “ ‘Ma tonga otoma ong kawa kale a izi,
ondooka wayo babaro orona zongka o de.’

content: Eyang belo ying, Yohana kala ko mana o gongnga a nyimi aromo aka a ngmenga. Pate ka nyimi ondooka waya baate akora Ashili wa kala wai.”
(Pate aromo amea ne kone oroka Yeso, ka ana o eesa emate makeke, nane kabare o bena, orona Ashili ya kap, aza o bena neya aromo ka Yohana wa eza ne o batisma.
Aza nyimi na maParisa ka na o rosa ngmǝ ka Ashili a nya Mosa ne nyane epa eka Ashili a kedeya aza one, o bena ne nyane a Yohana eze ne o batisma.)
Na Yeso lya izi ko beya na, “Aromo tomore teena ne tore eya?
Neye na bana yanaa a cikǝ ara ejamane ane rare tokpwe to ne, ane beya na,

content.text: te beya ying leera le ma'ade

content: Yohana ondo eza o batisma wa de, wata wa lyeeze epaolya ne, wata wa sooze manyi mo inabi ne, ne beya na, ‘Waye ko bere o buru.’
Kanza kena ka oromo ka de, aka ya lyeeza aka sooze, ne bekaana, ‘Laka na kando ko lyelyeza ko sosoza, kaja kana o eesa emate makeke, ka ana madinǝ.’
Pate ka nyimi andaaka ne kabare ka o ama Ashili, ne wore o bekaana o ama me wai ka maganggang.”
Yeso ka kwizǝ madinǝ ma ondaye yende
OParisa yende rare Yeso kane lye mete akwilǝ wai, naka ale a ka cikǝ aka lya epaolya me.
A nyimi apeng ame ondaye yende wa zene kawa cikǝ nyimi madinǝ ma wai. Nangka wa kone na Yeso ka deya a lya epaolya akwilǝ oParisa, na wa de ka manau mo waze o lebo ma emate e cak aka kagbwi.
Na ondaye me de, na wa itǝ a malo Yeso ating tobona te kai, a wa ya ruuzi
. Nangka mayizi ma wai ma jakazǝ tobona te Yeso, na wa pisi ka sekpwe se wai, a wa lembe tobona te Yeso aza o kona leba, malo nyimi a ondaye me cokome manau ma o waze o lebo a tobona te kai.

Nangka oParisa oka wa rare Yeso a lya mete wa laka epa eka ondaye me wa eza, na wa beke a nyimi lenyong le wai na, “Karomo kana kando ka o beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashilia kaaza, kaayo rosa ombela ondaye waana. Kanza kaayo rosa o bena ondaye me ondo madinǝ wai.”
Na Yeso bekaa oParisa me na, “Siman, eyang ka epa eka emea eyang bele o.” Nawa bekaana “Beka, Ondo baala.”
A Yeso bekaa wai na, “Oromo yende wa zene ka wa tare aromo leere o duru, ondo bora a tare wai o duru emate ogole mareka betuuru ko riiru, ondo leere me a tare wai o duru ogole o mareka tuuri esu.
Pate aromo leere me nane ta ama o ara o duru me ne, na oromo me wa baya ne ka emate me, o laka o, mana ba nyimi one, wayo waale a yeme o oromo omea wa baya ne ka emate me?”
Na Siman kabare na wa bekaana, “O laka ong ondooka a baya wai ka emate e cake.” Na Yeso kabare naka bekaana, “Maleo. Ba bekaa kap.”
Na Yeso laka ondaye me, aka bekaa Siman na, “Ba laka ondaye na? Ma deya ba akwilǝ au, ota ba nyang manyi kang kpizi tobona tong ne
, laka ondaye na wa kwizǝ tobona tong ka mayizi ma wai, kanza wa pisǝ ka sekpwe se wai.
Ota ba gwara ongmǝ kami ne
a were aka ma lyǝ akwilǝ au, laka ondaye na ko lyǝ wai, a wa taru aa lemba tobona tong na wata baya ne.
Ota ba cokoma manau okpwe ong ka o wore o emba ka o gongnga ong ne, laka ondaye na wa cokoma manau ma o waze o lebo a tobona tong.
Aza nyimi, a kwizǝ madinǝ ma wai ma cake maaka maya wai, wa wore o yeme o cake. Ondo oka a kwizǝ wai ma baate
, wa wore o yeme o baate.”
Na Yeso bekaa ondaye me na, “A kwizǝ madinǝ mau.”
Aromo me ne ya lya epaolya ka kai, nane bore o beya tokpwe tone na, “Mana ondo ona kawa ama o kwizǝ madinǝ ma cake?”
Na Yeso bekaa ondaye me na, “Nangka ba kabare ka mi, aza o bekaana ma era ang bozau, ale a cammo.”

footnotes.text: Waye ka ondo tesa geza a moole lewinu a taara te wai.
maYahuda maYahuda maya aromo akwilǝ Yahuda, a nyimi tobuudu betuuru ka leere maIsrela. Ana o baala angmǝ Ashili aka a nya ne were a Mosa ne suri a nyimi one. A were Yeso ka beya ne na aromo Isrela.
Kandaye kame kaya ruuzi aza o buru o madinǝ ma kai, kanza aka ya kona oleba na a kwizǝ madinǝ.
Ate akwilǝ wa wore o emba ageng aza o gbwizǝ tobona teena ka manyi. Nyimi maYahuda ezeze.
Nyimia maYahuda ne ezeze o wore o bekaana ne emba ogeng.
MaParisa ne laka na neta eza epa e buru a cake ne.
